name: security-indicators
description: Fictional credential-shaped strings, an encoded payload, a remote load pattern and a webhook endpoint.
notes: sf_suspicious uses values explicitly marked as examples, which the detector correctly downgrades to low confidence — that downgrade is itself under test, because example configuration is the most common source of false positives. The high-confidence path needs values shaped like live credentials; those are assembled at test time by tests/helpers/fabricated-credentials.ts rather than committed, so that nothing in this repository reads as a live secret. Tests assert that no value from either source reaches any output.
